plugins.name: CookingFix
plugins.description: Runtime shim for MakeItemSelection. (1) Fixes the Cooking (Manufacturing List) auto-select bug — upstream typo list[0].ITID → list[0]. (2) Silently no-ops the Ok button when no recipe is selected (mirrors native Ragexe hasSelection=0 guard). Temporary — remove after upstream fix merges + cyro redeploys. Note : the last-selected-ITID memory feature previously landed here in 1.1.0-a.1 has been moved to TabTargetNative for scope purity (autocraft UX = tab-target's domain).

plugins.name: CustomHomunAI
plugins.description: Custom Homunculus AI — Lua generator + portable AI-folder loader. Injects into AIDriver.HO_AI (doStringSync + Session.homCustomAI=true + HomunInformations.resetAI()) on pre-renewal targets (cyro.live). Panel exposes a 3-mode dropdown : Default (RO native AI) / Custom one-file (the inlined build, no pathfinding) / Custom next-gen (a portable folder loaded from disk, WITH pure-Lua pathfinding). Next-gen loads a complete AI folder the way AzzyAI/mirai/Ygg are shipped — an entry point that dofiles the rest — generated by `npm run chai:gen -- <preset> --folder` and imported by drag & drop (or a directory picker) into IndexedDB, then mounted into the Lua VM's MEMFS. No network, no host : the same bytes run on robrowser and on the official client. The panel rewrites chai/config.lua on every Apply and can export it. Pathfinding is pure Lua : a port of Utils/PathFinding.js (rAthena path.c lineage) over per-map 2-bit/cell .gatc walkability caches, chosen by a map-name feed the plugin writes into the VM. It sits behind the chaiHasPathTo(x0,y0,x1,y1,range) façade the target-pickup scan already used, replacing the JS bridge removed in 1.9.0. No grid loaded (no map name / missing cache / version mismatch) answers permissive, never off a stale grid. Composable 11-flag matrix : follow owner (AzzyAI-style throttle), follow ahead (predictive lead on the owner's inferred 8-way axis), cast skill, physical attack, kite, defend owner, follow owner target, pre-empt master casts (V_SKILL_TARGET via HomunAIShim), auto-attack mobs (V_HOMUNTYPE whitelist scan), flee own Marine Spheres (1142) + plant assist, take aggro. Flee and both kite modes retreat to a walkable, reachable spot inside the owner's vision, picked from 32 scored candidates with hysteresis (no left/right flip). 2-tab panel (Global + Mobs) with per-mob_id behavior toggles, per-mob skill caps / cooldowns and an experimental low-HP cast gate driven by learned damage. Soft-deps on HomunAIShim for V_SKILL_TARGET / V_AGGRESSOR, the SkillObject range-bug workaround and the packet-fed aggro channels — without it only castSkill / kite / followOwnerSkillTarget rows are disabled. Persistence per character with lazy migration of legacy presets. /chai toggles the panel.

plugins.name: DropNotifier
plugins.description: Desktop notification + optional beep when an item drops on the ground, filtered by name substrings and base-drop-rate rarity tiers. Reads the ItemDb plugin for item names + droppedBy rates. Settings persist via Preferences.

plugins.name: EmperiumHP
plugins.description: War of Emperium : an HP bar on the castle's Emperium, which the server never sends. Starts at the castle's maximum (168 430 at defense 100, pre-renewal) and follows every hit and every Sanctuary / Apple of Idun heal seen on it, on the client's own monster HP bar with « current / max · estimé » under it. Kept while that Emperium lives — out of sight, map change, death — and flagged « absent » when hits may have been missed meanwhile ; a new Emperium starts full. Real HP from the server replaces the estimate ; hidden WoE damage shows no bar. /emphp prints the estimate.

plugins.name: EnterConfirm
plugins.description: Press Enter to click the primary action button of the topmost whitelisted UI window (MakeItemSelection, ItemSelection, Refine). Mirrors NpcBox's native Enter handling for windows that don't have it. ItemSelection covers Sage Auto Spell (SA_AUTOSPELL), Skill Select (Fire Chain), and Item Identify.

plugins.name: HomunAIShim
plugins.description: Optional reactivity layer for the native AIDriver.HO_AI Lua VM. The AI source itself (custom-homun-ai, CHAI_BUILD 2.3.0+) owns everything expressible in pure Lua — the V_SKILL_TARGET / V_AGGRESSOR GetV shadow and the chaiGetMsg / chaiGetResMsg mailbox readers — so it runs with or without this plugin, and on the official client. What only JS can do stays here : NOTIFY_SKILL* / NOTIFY_ACT* observers that FILL _G.CHAI_OWNER_SKILL_TARGET (master's most-recent skill cast target, 3s TTL) and _G.CHAI_AGGRESSOR (master's most-recent attack target, 4s TTL) on packet receipt (no setInterval since 1.1.0), and a workaround for the AIDriver.SkillObject range bug (the engine compares a SQUARED distance against a linear range, so a skill only fires within ~sqrt(range) cells). Without the plugin those globals stay 0, every read degrades to "nothing known" and the AI falls back to its pure-Lua scans. Exposes `window.__RO_HomunAIShim` (apply, startAggroPolling, stopAggroPolling, PREAMBLE) for consumer plugins like custom-homun-ai. Note : `opts.defensive` and `opts.whitelist` are deprecated since 1.1.0 — consumers should run a pure-Lua GetActors() scan in their own AI source instead. Targets cyro.live pre-renewal.

plugins.name: HomunGrowthLog
plugins.description: Records every homunculus level-up locally: the exact base-stat roll (hp/sp/str/agi/vit/int/dex/luk) read from the server's green 'Growth:' chat line, paired with the before/after ZC_PROPERTY_HOMUN snapshots so the derived-stat delta (atk, matk, hit, crit, def, mdef, flee) is captured too. Draggable panel with the per-level table + cumulative totals, Download JSON / Download CSV, and Clear. Passive: no packet is modified, nothing is sent to the server. Toggle with /homungrowth (alias /hgl).

plugins.name: ItemIconFallback
plugins.description: Serve a placeholder icon when an item-icon texture (data/texture/<interface>/item/*.bmp) never resolves, so the inventory / cart / selection slot always paints and stays draggable + clickable. Wraps Client.loadFile for that path only : an explicit load error, or no callback at all within 3s, paints the client's own Apple icon (item/사과.bmp, the official clients' default for an unresolvable item), or a generated 24x24 '?' PNG when the Apple fails too. Covers the two upstream dead-ends — MemoryItem.onerror with an onload-only caller (nothing fires, blank forever) and Texture.load's missing img.onerror (the Memory slot stays pending forever, Memory.exist() keeps it from ever being re-requested). A real icon arriving late still overwrites the placeholder. Failing filenames are logged once each to the console and to the local dev-log server (file item-icon-fallback) so the underlying missing / undecodable assets can be identified.

plugins.name: RoItemInfo
plugins.description: Item database lookup — /iteminfo /ii <id|name> via native Commands, producedBy/consumedBy/unlocks details, mob sheets (/mobinfo /mi, or a Dropped by row) with the mob sprite, icon resolution via GRF/CDN. Consumes the ItemDb plugin for the data layer.

plugins.name: PartyBuffBot
plugins.description: Support bot — auto-casts Priest buffs (Blessing / Increase AGI / Magnificat / Gloria) and auto-heals party members (+ their Alchemist homunculus, + yourself) up to full HP. Buff state is tracked per-member from ZC_MSG_STATE_CHANGE packets (on-screen members only); heal is driven by ZC_NOTIFY_HP_TO_GROUPM. Window toggle via /buffbot. Job auto-detected (Priest family).

plugins.name: RoRadio
plugins.description: In-game music player — plays BGM from the client's mp3nametable, manages a playlist with shuffle/repeat, mutes the map BGM while playing, and survives map changes uninterrupted via its own <audio> element.

plugins.name: RespawnRadar
plugins.description: MVP / respawn helper — kill tracking, respawn windows, minimap marks, per-mob kill counters, and a map sweep that walks until a watched mob is in sight.
plugins.summary: Know when each MVP respawns, see it on the minimap, and let /rr hunt search the map for it.

plugins.name: RoSync
plugins.description: Keeps settings, window positions and plugin data in sync between pages that share a sync code (e.g. cyro.live and a local build), peer to peer over WebRTC (PeerJS), end-to-end encrypted. Per page: sync plugins & data (each page installs its own build of the other's plugins from the registry) or data only. /sync opens the panel, /sync now pushes this page's data as the reference and/or downloads it as a ro-backup file.

plugins.name: Rocache
plugins.description: Persistent asset cache for the roBrowser asset server (ROConfig.remoteClient), built on fetch interception : the native plugin manager's fetch-intercept lib (needs ROConfig.fetchIntercept on) or the userscript Framework.fetchIntercept (since framework 3.10.0-a.13). Three pluggable storage backends behind a unified interface : `opfs` (OPFS SyncAccessHandle, fastest), `cacheapi` (universal Cache Storage, S2 path), `fs` (Chromium-only legacy webkitRequestFileSystem with ETag sidecar). Cascade default `opfs > cacheapi > fs` ; `/rocache` UI radio lets the user pick + auto-detects capability per browser. Per-file freshness via cyro's Express ETag (If-None-Match) ; default mode `async` revalidates in background with a 1h throttle ; `strict` races a 100ms conditional GET. Invalidation is a manual user action via /rocache → Invalidate cache. NEW in 1.2 : « Bulk download » button pre-populates the active backend with a curated pre-re asset list (~3.8 GB, ~34k files) hosted on catbox.moe, fetched once + cached in IndexedDB. Worker-side orchestrator with capped concurrency (default 10, 1-32), per-attempt 30s timeout, 3 retries with exponential backoff on 5xx/network/timeout (no retry on 4xx — known combo-probe noise). Visible progress bar + pause/resume/cancel. On install, sets `localStorage.RO_DISABLE_FILESYSTEM=1` so the host hides the bundle's FileSystem at boot (the userscript framework patches FileSystem.js `_available` ; the native manager starts its asset worker as `nofs`) — the bundle then goes through `fetch()` for every asset (Firefox path) while `webkitRequestFileSystem*` stay available on the worker for the `fs` backend. Reload required after install for the patch to take effect. On uninstall the flag is cleared, FileSystem comes back on the next reload. Backend switches don't migrate data (out of scope, deferred to a later session). Settings persist in localStorage.rocache_settings and propagate to the asset worker via __RO_setConfig.

plugins.name: SellAll
plugins.description: A « Sell all » button in the item list footer of the NPC sell window moves every listed stack to the selling list, as if each one was dropped with the quantity prompt skipped (NpcStore.receiveInventoryItemStack). Sends nothing : the player confirms with Sell. Favorites follow the favorite tab's deal lock (the engine leaves them out of the list while it is closed) ; on an inventory whose lock the player cannot see (InventoryV0, V1, V2) they always stay. No button on a bundle without receiveInventoryItemStack.
plugins.summary: One button in the NPC sell window puts every item in the selling list.

plugins.name: StorageDeposit
plugins.description: /deposit, or the Quick stack button at the bottom right of the inventory — while the personal storage is open, moves to it every inventory stack whose item the storage already holds. Stackables matched by item id ; equipment, equipped ammo, favorites and rentals stay put. One deposit at a time, each waiting for the server's answer plus a short human-like pause ; stops with a chat line when the storage is full. Refuses to run on the guild storage.

plugins.name: StorageWithdrawSets
plugins.description: /withdraw opens a window of named crafting sets — a textarea of lines per craft like '2 Frill', 'Red Gemstone x1' or an item id ; a line with no count (a Creation Guide) is held once, never multiplied. Each set has a ×1 / ×10 / ×20 / ×50 choice. Withdraw counts what the inventory already holds, takes the rest from the cart then the personal storage, and when the stock falls short prepares the max makeable. The storage is opened only when needed (@storage when the « @storage available » box is ticked, else or if it does not open the nearest Kafra in sight), its withdraws go first and it is closed before any cart move (rAthena ignores cart moves while a storage is open). Red chat lines name the items that cap the count and any refused request ; one white line gives the crafts ready. /withdraw <set> [N] runs without the window. Presets: Alchemist (one Twilight Alchemy 3 cast), Poison Bottle, Fireproof / Coldproof / Earthproof / Thunderproof Potion. Sets are saved per account ; the guild storage is refused.
plugins.summary: Pick a crafting set, choose how many, and the ingredients come out of your Cart and Storage.

plugins.name: TabTargetNative
plugins.description: Tab / Shift+Tab / Enter targeting with native UIComponent panel; the lock key (default: the key above Tab — ² on Windows AZERTY, @ on Mac AZERTY — rebindable from the panel) or /focus locks the target (nothing moves it — Tab, list or world click, manual attack/skill, homun/merc — Space and skill keys keep hitting it ; survives leaving sight, released on death or toggling it again) and auto-focus on manual attack. Optional per-character checkbox auto-focuses the mob the player's own homunculus/mercenary attacks (melee or skill), with owner-priority: the player's last manual target holds focus for a few seconds so a minion hit won't yank it away. /tt and /tabtarget chat commands toggle the panel. Digit row 1-9 (layout-agnostic) auto-targets the locked mob on native skillbar F2 slots 1-9, shown as two panel rows (5 + 4) of split buttons: the number (left) casts, the right segment is a tri-state per-slot mode (off / A=auto-craft (hold) / S=self-cast), persisted per character. A holds a key to loop cast → confirm MakeItemSelection → re-cast (Prepare Potion, Arrow Making, Cooking…) and remembers the last confirmed ITID to re-select it on subsequent cycles (uniform across crafts, falls back to list[0] if the memory isn't in the new list, resets on page reload); S auto-casts the skill on the player (PLACE/TRAP under-foot, others on player GID); Ctrl+digit falls through to the native skillbar. The « Mobs & Players » list holds the mobs on a normal map; on a GvG map (WoE) it switches by itself to the hostile players (outside our party, guild and allied guilds, shown with their guild) by distance, then their homunculi, then the enemy guardians, then the Emperium — the order Tab cycles — and manual attacks/skills on them move the focus too. A mob rare on its map (at most 5 % of the map's mobs or at most 3 there, counted from the ItemDb mob sheets) gets a « rare ×N » badge on its row and a white minimap cross at the cell it was last seen, kept once it leaves the screen, removed on its death or a map change. Triple-click the titlebar to toggle the legacy Prev/Attack/Next debug buttons at runtime.

plugins.name: XpSessions
plugins.description: XP Sessions — base and job XP per hour, kills per hour and duration, per hunting session. Start / Stop, or let it stop by itself after a few minutes without XP or kill (the session then ends on its last gain). On Stop the name field takes the focus, pre-filled with a name read off the hunt: the mob (one mob ≥ 95 % of the kills), else the map, else the dungeon, else « Mixte <date> ». A typed name is kept, an auto one follows the rules. History with CSV export and a two-click Clear. Passive: nothing is sent to the server. Toggle with /xpsessions (alias /xps); /xps start, /xps stop.
